svg.title: Visual self-modeling with path and time memory
svg.desc: A single camera faces the middle of a two-section soft arm. An elevated oblique drawing viewpoint reveals their perspective relationship. The arm geometry is based on a logged large-deformation control example. Current-input reference coordinates and two recurrent memory contributions are summed before planar geometric reconstruction. Path and time plots are operator responses to an illustrative loading, reversal and holding input, not sensor measurements.
